bedrockpackloader.help.tooltip: How to install Bedrock resource packs
bedrockpackloader.help.title: Installing Bedrock resource packs
bedrockpackloader.help.formats: Formats: a pack folder, a .zip or a .mcpack file. The pack needs a manifest.json at its root (or inside a single top-level folder). .brarchive files inside the pack are read too.
bedrockpackloader.help.location: Location: put the pack in the "bedrock_packs" folder of the game directory. The "resourcepacks" folder is scanned as well.
bedrockpackloader.help.enable: Enable: open Options > Resource Packs, move the pack marked "Bedrock pack" to the selected list and click Done. A pack with subpacks shows one entry per subpack.
bedrockpackloader.help.notes: Notes: textures replace vanilla ones only when the name matches and the size fits the vanilla layout. Player models and animations need the pack to define minecraft:player.
